items.name: MovementSurfaceAngle
items.desc:
Tests the angle of the surface that the ref is walking on against a numeric value.
The angle is calculated by comparing the surface's normal vector and the ref's forward vector.

components.desc: Whether the angle values are in degrees or radians.
Enable to try to access the navmesh first to calculate the surface's normal vector, if possible. Will be more inaccurate, but less volatile.

The smoothing factor controls how much the previous value influences the new value.

A factor closer to 0 means the smoothing will respond more slowly to changes, while a factor closer to 1 means it will respond more quickly. 1 is effectively instant.

items.name: PRESET
items.desc:
Evaluate a condition preset defined in the replacer mod in place of this condition. Useful if you want to reuse the same set of conditions in multiple submods.

Manage condition presets in the replacer mod and don't forget to save the config!
